hooks.text: 一至四人靠近距离语音在裂隙中协作，还能自由选择第一或第三人称视角。
hooks.excerpt: 1–4 PLAYER SURVIVAL WITH PROX CHAT Play solo or with up to three friends to tackle the horrors of each rift. Coordination is key, survival is not guaranteed. Proximity voice chat enabled. Supports both third and first person play.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 裂隙每次重组生态、布局和随机危险，深入后威胁持续升级并迫使队伍改计划。
hooks.excerpt: No two expeditions are the same. Each rift generates new biomes, shifting layouts, randomised hazards, and escalating threats that force your team to adapt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 重力手套能一次抓、搬和投掷多个物体，异界原料还要冒险运去裂隙站出售。
hooks.excerpt: Use the Gravity Gauntlet to grab, carry, and throw multiple objects at once. Harvest bizarre rift-grown ingredients and sell them at rift stations while surviving the creatures that stalk each dimension.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
